description: Defines structures, classes, and functions related to SHA256 hash values, including HashValue class, comparison operators, and hash lookup functions within the net namespace.

classes.name: SHA256HashValue
classes.description: Represents a SHA256 hash as an array of 32 unsigned chars.

classes.name: HashValue
classes.description: Encapsulates a hash value with serialization, deserialization, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two SHA256HashValue instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two SHA256HashValue instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Checks if one SHA256HashValue is less than another.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if one SHA256HashValue is greater than another.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if one SHA256HashValue is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one SHA256HashValue is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: HashValue::FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a HashValue from a string input.

methods.name: HashValue::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the HashValue to a string.

methods.name: HashValue::size
methods.description: Returns the size of the hash data.

methods.name: HashValue::data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the hash data.

methods.name: HashValue::tag
methods.description: Returns the tag indicating the hash type.
